001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.format;
002
003import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty;
005
006/**
007 * Builder to create {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter }.
008 * Formats each event as a JSON5 (or JSON) object, one line unless pretty printed in
009 * full, for switching an application to structured logging without adding a module,
010 * for example:
011 * <code>{time:"2026-10-05T15:04:05.123Z",level:"INFO" ,logger:"com.example.App",threadId:"1",threadName:"main",msg:"hello world",requestId:"42"}</code>.
012 * <p>
013 * The fields use logfmt's names: <code>time</code> (UTC instant with milliseconds),
014 * <code>level</code>, <code>logger</code>, the thread fields chosen with
015 * {@link ThreadFields} (by default <code>threadId</code> and
016 * <code>threadName</code>), <code>msg</code>, and for a throwable <code>error</code>
017 * (its <code>toString()</code>) and <code>stacktrace</code>. Every value, key values
018 * and thread id included, is a string, or <code>null</code> for a key value without
019 * one. For a specific schema (ECS, GELF, Logstash) and more options use the
020 * <code>rainbowgum-json</code> module.
021 * <p>
022 * With JSON5, values can be colored like the TTLL formatter, and by default the level
023 * is padded after its closing quote so the value stays the level name:
024 * <code>level:"INFO" ,logger:...</code>. With JSON the color, theme, and pretty print
025 * are ignored, so the output stays plain JSON.
026 * <table class="table">
027 * <caption><strong>Properties retrieved from LogProperties</strong></caption>
028 * <tr>
029 * <th>Property Pattern</th>
030 * <th>Type</th>
031 * <th>Required</th>
032 * <th>Default</th>
033 * <th>Description</th>
034 * </tr>
035 * <tr>
036 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.json5.format" }</code></td>
037 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
038 * <td><code>true</code></td>
039 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesFormatterBuilder.Format#JSON5 json5}</td>
040 * <td>JSON5 (default), which leaves identifier keys unquoted, or JSON.</td>
041 * </tr>
042 * <tr>
043 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.json5.keyValues" }</code></td>
044 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
045 * <td><code>true</code></td>
046 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesPlacement#MERGED merged}</td>
047 * <td>Where key values go, see {@link KeyValuesPlacement}.</td>
048 * </tr>
049 * <tr>
050 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.json5.thread" }</code></td>
051 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
052 * <td><code>true</code></td>
053 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields#BOTH both}</td>
054 * <td>Which thread fields, see {@link ThreadFields}.</td>
055 * </tr>
056 * <tr>
057 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.json5.prettyPrint" }</code></td>
058 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
059 * <td><code>true</code></td>
060 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5PrettyPrint#LEVEL_PADDING level_padding}</td>
061 * <td>JSON5 only, added whitespace, see {@link Json5PrettyPrint}.</td>
062 * </tr>
063 * <tr>
064 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.json5.color" }</code></td>
065 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
066 * <td><code>false</code></td>
067 * <td><code>null</code></td>
068 * <td>JSON5 only, whether to color values, see {@link TTLL.ColorMode}.</td>
069 * </tr>
070 * <tr>
071 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.json5.theme" }</code></td>
072 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
073 * <td><code>false</code></td>
074 * <td><code>null</code></td>
075 * <td>JSON5 only, which colors, see {@link TTLL.ColorTheme}.</td>
076 * </tr>
077 * </table>
078 */
079public final class Json5FormatterBuilder implements io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogBuilder<Json5FormatterBuilder,io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter> {
080
081        /**
082         * The properties to be retrieved from config will have
083         * this prefix.
084         */
085        static final String PROPERTY_PREFIX = "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.json5.";
086        
087        /**
088         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_format } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesFormatterBuilder.Format</code> JSON5 (default), which leaves identifier keys unquoted, or JSON.
089         */
090        static final String PROPERTY_format = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "format";
091        /**
092         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_keyValues } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesPlacement</code> Where key values go, see {@link KeyValuesPlacement}.
093         */
094        static final String PROPERTY_keyValues = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "keyValues";
095        /**
096         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_thread } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields</code> Which thread fields, see {@link ThreadFields}.
097         */
098        static final String PROPERTY_thread = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "thread";
099        /**
100         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_prettyPrint } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5PrettyPrint</code> JSON5 only, added whitespace, see {@link Json5PrettyPrint}.
101         */
102        static final String PROPERTY_prettyPrint = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "prettyPrint";
103        /**
104         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_color } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.ColorMode</code> JSON5 only, whether to color values, see {@link TTLL.ColorMode}.
105         */
106        static final String PROPERTY_color = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "color";
107        /**
108         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_theme } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.ColorTheme</code> JSON5 only, which colors, see {@link TTLL.ColorTheme}.
109         */
110        static final String PROPERTY_theme = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "theme";
111        
112        private final String propertyPrefix;
113        final String property_format;
114        final String property_keyValues;
115        final String property_thread;
116        final String property_prettyPrint;
117        final String property_color;
118        final String property_theme;
119        
120        private final java.lang.String name;
121        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesFormatterBuilder.Format format = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesFormatterBuilder.Format.JSON5;
122        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesPlacement keyValues = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesPlacement.MERGED;
123        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields thread = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields.BOTH;
124        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5PrettyPrint prettyPrint = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5PrettyPrint.LEVEL_PADDING;
125        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ColorMode color = null;
126        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ColorTheme theme = null;
127        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ServiceRegistry serviceRegistry;
128        
129        /**
130         * Create a builder for {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter }.
131         * @param name will fill <code>{name}</code> in <code>logging.appender.{name}.encoder.json5.</code>. Encoder name, used for property lookup.
132         */
133        public Json5FormatterBuilder(
134                        java.lang.String name
135                        ) {
136                try {
137                        java.util.Map<String,String> prefixParameters = java.util.Map.of(
138                                        "name", name
139                                );
140                        this.propertyPrefix = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_PREFIX, prefixParameters);
141                        this.name = name;
142                        property_format = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_format, prefixParameters);
143                        property_keyValues = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_keyValues, prefixParameters);
144                        property_thread = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_thread, prefixParameters);
145                        property_prettyPrint = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_prettyPrint, prefixParameters);
146                        property_color = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_color, prefixParameters);
147                        property_theme = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_theme, prefixParameters);
148                }
149                catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
150                        throw LogProperty.ValidationException.of(this.getClass(), e);
151                }
152        }
153
154
155        /**
156         * Sets serviceRegistry.
157         * Where themes chosen by name in properties are looked up.
158         * Default is <code>null</code>.
159         * @param serviceRegistry not configurable through properties Where themes chosen by name in properties are looked up.
160         * @return this builder.
161         */
162        public Json5FormatterBuilder serviceRegistry(io.jstach.rainbowgum.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ServiceRegistry serviceRegistry) {
163                this.serviceRegistry = serviceRegistry;
164                return this;
165        }
166
167        
168        /**
169         * Sets <strong>required</strong> format.
170         * JSON5 (default), which leaves identifier keys unquoted, or JSON.
171         * Default is {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesFormatterBuilder.Format#JSON5 json5}.
172         * @param format <code>{@value #PROPERTY_format } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesFormatterBuilder.Format</code> JSON5 (default), which leaves identifier keys unquoted, or JSON.
173         * @return this builder.
174         */
175        public Json5FormatterBuilder format(io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesFormatterBuilder.Format format) {
176                this.format = format;
177                return this;
178        }
179        
180        /**
181         * Sets <strong>required</strong> keyValues.
182         * Where key values go, see {@link KeyValuesPlacement}.
183         * Default is {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesPlacement#MERGED merged}.
184         * @param keyValues <code>{@value #PROPERTY_keyValues } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesPlacement</code> Where key values go, see {@link KeyValuesPlacement}.
185         * @return this builder.
186         */
187        public Json5FormatterBuilder keyValues(io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesPlacement keyValues) {
188                this.keyValues = keyValues;
189                return this;
190        }
191        
192        /**
193         * Sets <strong>required</strong> thread.
194         * Which thread fields, see {@link ThreadFields}.
195         * Default is {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields#BOTH both}.
196         * @param thread <code>{@value #PROPERTY_thread } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields</code> Which thread fields, see {@link ThreadFields}.
197         * @return this builder.
198         */
199        public Json5FormatterBuilder thread(io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields thread) {
200                this.thread = thread;
201                return this;
202        }
203        
204        /**
205         * Sets <strong>required</strong> prettyPrint.
206         * JSON5 only, added whitespace, see {@link Json5PrettyPrint}.
207         * Default is {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5PrettyPrint#LEVEL_PADDING level_padding}.
208         * @param prettyPrint <code>{@value #PROPERTY_prettyPrint } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5PrettyPrint</code> JSON5 only, added whitespace, see {@link Json5PrettyPrint}.
209         * @return this builder.
210         */
211        public Json5FormatterBuilder prettyPrint(io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5PrettyPrint prettyPrint) {
212                this.prettyPrint = prettyPrint;
213                return this;
214        }
215        
216        /**
217         * Sets color.
218         * JSON5 only, whether to color values, see {@link TTLL.ColorMode}.
219         * Default is <code>null</code>.
220         * @param color <code>{@value #PROPERTY_color } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.ColorMode</code> JSON5 only, whether to color values, see {@link TTLL.ColorMode}.
221         * @return this builder.
222         */
223        public Json5FormatterBuilder color(io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ColorMode color) {
224                this.color = color;
225                return this;
226        }
227        
228        /**
229         * Sets theme.
230         * JSON5 only, which colors, see {@link TTLL.ColorTheme}.
231         * Default is <code>null</code>.
232         * @param theme <code>{@value #PROPERTY_theme } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.ColorTheme</code> JSON5 only, which colors, see {@link TTLL.ColorTheme}.
233         * @return this builder.
234         */
235        public Json5FormatterBuilder theme(io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ColorTheme theme) {
236                this.theme = theme;
237                return this;
238        }
239        
240        /**
241         * Creates {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter } from this builder.
242         * @return {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter }.
243         */
244        public io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter build() {
245                try {
246                        return io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5Formatter.of(
247                                        this.name
248                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_format, this.format)
249                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_keyValues, this.keyValues)
250                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_thread, this.thread)
251                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_prettyPrint, this.prettyPrint)
252                                        , this.color
253                                        , this.theme
254                                        , this.serviceRegistry
255                                        );
256                }
257                catch (IllegalArgumentException | LogProperty.PropertyMissingException e) {
258                        throw LogProperty.ValidationException.of(this.getClass(), e);
259                }
260        }
261        
262        @Override
263        public Json5FormatterBuilder fromProperties(LogProperties properties) {
264                var __v = LogProperty.Validator.of(this.getClass());
265                var _format = properties.forKey(property_format).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5Formatter.convertFormat(_v)).or(this.format).validate(__v);
266                var _keyValues = properties.forKey(property_keyValues).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5Formatter.convertKeyValues(_v)).or(this.keyValues).validate(__v);
267                var _thread = properties.forKey(property_thread).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5Formatter.convertThread(_v)).or(this.thread).validate(__v);
268                var _prettyPrint = properties.forKey(property_prettyPrint).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5Formatter.convertPrettyPrint(_v)).or(this.prettyPrint).validate(__v);
269                var _color = properties.forKey(property_color).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5Formatter.convertColor(_v)).or(this.color).validateIfError(__v);
270                var _theme = properties.forKey(property_theme).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5Formatter.convertTheme(_v)).or(this.theme).validateIfError(__v);
271                __v.validate();
272                this.format = _format.value();
273                this.keyValues = _keyValues.value();
274                this.thread = _thread.value();
275                this.prettyPrint = _prettyPrint.value();
276                this.color = _color.valueOrNull();
277                this.theme = _theme.valueOrNull();
278                return this;
279        }
280        
281        /**
282         * The interpolated property prefix: {@value #PROPERTY_PREFIX}.
283         * @return resolved prefix which should end with a "<code>.</code>".
284         */
285        @Override
286        public String propertyPrefix() {
287                return this.propertyPrefix;
288        }
289
